goal.claim: Click grid blocks to toggle color; match target shown by mini "knob" cells (3x3 preview of their neighborhood).

goal6.claim: Level 6 board: yellow blocks each with small pink notch at top-center; legend Y/N; some W/g/G minis.

hud.claim: Bottom orange row = step bar, 2 units per click, 64 start = 32 clicks/level. Top-right 2 squares = legend of the two colors.

knoblegend.claim: Knob mini = 3x3 target of its neighborhood; center swatch = color that WHITE cells mean, gray = other panel color. L3 confirmed (mixed R/O centers).

l5rule.claim: L5: 2 colors N(base)/p; minis live-static target: shade W=swatch color, g=other, G=non-block. Pink-cross cells are flipper blocks: click toggles self+4 orthogonal neighbors.

l6rule.claim: L6: click on notched block toggles SELF + cell directly ABOVE (notch=up arrow). Minis: W=swatch(N), g=other(Y), G=non-block.
